Name: Jeriah, Son of Hebron
Summary: First son of Hebron in David's divisions.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:19; 1 Chronicles 24:23: First son of Hebron in David's divisions.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeriah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
